An element in the tree: the `CTMLElement` it is, the properties written on it, the styles it carries and the children under it.

This is what a callback is handed and what `DOMContext.getElementById` finds. Setting a property or a style here marks the tree as changed on up to the root, so whatever is drawing it lays it out again on the next frame and nothing has to be told twice.

```java
import net.tutla.craftytml.client.dom.DOMTreeElement;
```
